# Axiocairn MCP

> Check holdings exposure, run what-if scenarios, estimate trading cost and capacity, review backtest discipline, and read published research reports with their data dates and limits, through a hosted MCP server.

Research information, not investment advice. Account authorization is required. Access follows account permissions. Client compatibility must be checked individually. The connection analyzes holdings you provide, stores the daily-close conditions you set, and reads existing reports. Where your plan allows, it can request a new stock model assessment, which uses generation allowance. Company research and event research are not generated on request yet. It does not place trades or manage accounts.

## Connect

- General Streamable HTTP endpoint, verified in claude.ai web on 2026-10-27: https://axiocairn.com/mcp
- ChatGPT endpoint, verified in ChatGPT web on 2026-10-27: https://axiocairn.com/mcp/chatgpt
- Grok endpoint, verification pending: https://axiocairn.com/mcp/grok
- Muse endpoint, verification pending: https://axiocairn.com/mcp/muse
- [Connection guide](https://axiocairn.com/en/assistant): setup and account authorization steps.

## Tools

Areas covered: holdings exposure and what-if scenarios; trading cost and capacity; backtest discipline and data-quality checks; saved daily-close conditions; published research reports, schedules and the weekly House View; help topics and plan details. After authorization, tools/list is the authority for current names, descriptions and input schemas. Unauthenticated discovery returns an authorization error.

Preserve report links, data dates, missing fields and limitations. Expected publication times do not establish availability. Weekends and market holidays retain the latest trading day's data; today's report may be absent. Reader is the free tier, with limited look-ups, delayed briefs and limited history.
